channel.description: Latest articles from The Golf Channel (golfchannel.com)

item.title: First round of Genesis Invitational resumes after three-hour suspension
item.description: Steady rain puddled greens and led PGA Tour officials to suspend play in the opening round of the Genesis Invitational. Rory McIlroy birdied his first hole once play resumed a little after 1 p.m. local time.

item.title: LPGA Highlights 2026: Honda LPGA Thailand, Round 1
item.description: Top-ranked Jeeno Thitikul and Lydia Ko shot 5-under 67s during the first round at the 2026 Honda LPGA Thailand. They were in a group of 10 players tied for sixth. Nasa Hataoka and Chanettee Wannasaen lead after 18 holes at Siam Country Club Old Course.

item.title: PGA president Don Rea removed from PGA Tour board, to focus on 'member-first priorities'
item.description: The PGA confirmed that Rea Jr., whose two-year term as president expires at the end of the year, was removed from the PGA Tour Inc. board last November.

item.title: Bunker in the middle of the green? McIlroy chips over it
item.description: The par-3 sixth at Riviera Country Club has a bunker in the middle of the green. Rory McIlroy found himself on the wrong side of it Thursday, but played an expert chip shot -- on the green -- to save par.

item.title: McIlroy embracing the shot-shaping challenge of Riviera
item.description: Rory McIlroy talked to Golf Channel's Todd Lewis after his 5-under 66 in the first round of the 2026 Genesis Invitational. McIlroy said he's hoping the wind will dry out the course and allow Riviera to play like Riviera can.

item.title: Rory McIlroy clubhouse leader at Genesis Invitational as Scottie Scheffler sits tied in last place
item.description: Rory McIlroy and Jacob Bridgeman are tied in the clubhouse after shooting 5-under 66s but Aaron Rai has a stroke advantage with two more holes to play Friday morning at Riviera Country Club.

item.title: Tour 'very confident' Genesis second round will finish Friday
item.description: With first-round play carrying over a day because of inclement weather, Todd Lewis says the PGA Tour is "very confident" Round 2 of the Genesis Invitational will be completed Friday.

item.title: Viktor Hovland gaining driver confidence, still eyeing gap in new trees Riv's 15th
item.description: Hovland shot 2-under 69 Thursday at Riviera as he made nice progress with his driver, so much so that trees planted to stop him from playing No. 15 down No. 17 might not be enough.

item.title: What's wrong with Scheffler at the start of tournaments?
item.description: Scottie Scheffler sits in a tie for last place with Keegan Bradley at the 2026 Genesis Invitational. Scheffler was 5-over par through 10 holes when play was suspended due to darkness at Riviera Country Club on Thursday. It's the third straight week the world's top-ranked player struggled in his opening round.

item.title: PGA Tour Highlights 2026: Genesis Invitational, Round 1
item.description: Highlights from the opening round of the 2026 Genesis Invitational, where weather caused a lengthy suspension, but Rory McIlroy found his way to the top of the leaderboard -- and Scottie Scheffler to the bottom of it.
